metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'MDE - WinRM Remote Command Execution'

properties.description:
Detects a command or script interpreter spawned by wsmprovhost.exe, the WinRM
host process. Anything that reaches a Windows host over WinRM
(Invoke-Command / Enter-PSSession / a remote-session tool) executes as a child
of wsmprovhost, so this pattern is the cleanest endpoint-side indicator of
remote-management-tool lateral movement (T1021.006). Commonly seen in
hands-on-keyboard intrusions and in the Akira/BlackByte affiliate playbooks.
properties.query:
// Interpreters and reconnaissance utilities that arrive through a WinRM
// session. Build/CI and configuration-management agents land here too — see
// tuningGuidance for the parent-process allow-list.
let remote_shell_children = dynamic([
  "cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cscript.exe", "wscript.exe",
  "net.exe", "net1.exe", "whoami.exe", "hostname.exe", "ipconfig.exe",
  "systeminfo.exe", "nltest.exe", "wevtutil.exe", "sc.exe",
  "schtasks.exe", "reg.exe", "wmic.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe",
  "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "curl.exe", "quser.exe",
  "tasklist.exe", "netstat.exe", "arp.exe", "route.exe", "dsquery.exe"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wsmprovhost.exe"
| where FileName in~ (remote_shell_children)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{FileName}} was launched by wsmprovhost.exe (WinRM) on {{DeviceName}} under account {{AccountName}}: {{ProcessCommandLine}}
